description.value: Villa Eyrie Resort is a luxury mountain resort perched high above Finlayson Arm on the Malahat, with panoramic views stretching to the Olympic Mountains and Mount Baker. Inspired by Lake Como and Italian alpine architecture, the property features elegantly appointed suites, the Alpina Restaurant, a Tuscan Spa, and curated experiences including mushroom foraging and winery visits. Named among TripAdvisor's top 10% of hotels worldwide, it sits directly on the Trans-Canada Highway corridor between Victoria and the rest of Vancouver Island — a natural overnight stop for long-distance touring cyclists.
